BUILD QUEUE (lesson from Wesleyan Village, 2026-10-06): the cost_report_fraud scheme put Wesleyan at the 98th peer percentile (hcris_cost_anomaly 0.984, subscore 0.95) in BOTH the v6 and v7 runs, yet it sat in priority tier 6_none with zero concept signals, because the leads ranking is dollar-weighted on the Medicaid HCPCS file and a nursing home's revenue (the LT per diem) has no HCPCS code: Wesleyan shows $1.7M of assisted-living waiver lines against a multi-million per-diem stream the file cannot see. Nursing facilities (taxonomy 31xx) are therefore systematically under-ranked. Fix: for 31xx orgs use the HCRIS cost report as the dollar basis (Worksheet S-3 Medicaid days and total patient revenue, G-2/G-3 revenue) via the CCN crosswalk, and let cost_report_fraud + worthless_services + ownership_integrity carry the rank for that class.
